spec.description: Reject missing input with a clear error.

files.content:
import test from 'node:test'
import assert from 'node:assert'
import { execute } from '../lib/impl.js'
test('contract', async () => {
  assert.deepEqual(await execute({ value: 1 }), { value: 1 })
  await assert.rejects(() => execute({}), /value required/)
})
